title: DEC-204: Local database authority for Claude Slice 12 continuation (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: The 2026-10-22 Codex handoff held all Docker/SQL use; Slice 12 has 296 criteria (9 verified, 66 partial, 221 uncited) and 222 of 647 citations are pgTAP, so SQL criteria cannot close without a local database.
- **Options considered**: (A) pgTAP via docs/handoffs/2026-10-14-claude-s12/lanes/lane-db-alt-staged.sh on ALT stack wejammin_ev under CI/quiet/ALT/reset locks, plus canonical `pnpm db:verify` then `pnpm validate` on the default stack at reviewed checkpoints with lanes paused under the CI flock; (B) ALT lanes only, no default-stack reset until phase close; (C) no database, unit work only.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. The DEC-203 native upgrade-tracing proof and the proposed native-finality metadata audit window remain HELD and unapproved; this grant does not cover them, privileged commands, lock deletion, or remote/hosted targets.
- **Downstream**: Slice 12 SQL lanes and evidence; canonical gate checkpoints for Slices 12-17.
- **Reversibility**: High (process authority).

title: DEC-205: Protected locale-variant read for the translate page (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: FE03 (CmsLocaleVariantForm row ~891, page ~1073/1641) requires each localizable field current translation, its CMS-03C-20 LocaleFieldResolution (own value, fallback source locale, no_fallback missing/stale), the derived variant state and the read-only fallback order; BE03c serves only the CMS-03C-04 POST write, CMS-03C-20 has no browser route, CMS-03B-11 is scoped to the draft head locale and the fallback order is only readable via CMS-03A-07 (schema-registry roles). Boundaries SG-S12-05/06/07 (lane-web-locale-report.md).
- **Options considered**: (A) new protected GET /api/v1/cms/entries/{entryId}/locales/{locale} authorized exactly like CMS-03C-04 returning current variant values, derived state, stale field ids, per-field CMS-03C-20 resolutions and the active fallback order; (B) same read without resolutions; (C) keep the page save-blocked.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22 (mirrors DEC-195). 404 hidden/absent entry or locale outside supportedLocales; 403 visible without edit authority; returns no other owner data.
- **Downstream**: BE03c route/validation/matrix/catalog/authority rows and resource; IA03 CMS-15; FE03 page/form rows; contracts; SQL read + platform_api wrapper; Worker route; Web locale page loader (lift SG-S12-05/06/07); affected Slice 12 criteria (owner-approved cascade).
- **Reversibility**: High (additive read).

title: DEC-206: Protected composition-instance list read for the composition page (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: FE03 CmsCompositionInstanceList (row ~887, props ~1509) needs the draft revision instances, but CMS-03B-11 EntryDraftDetailResource carries only fields and relations and BE03c has no list read; after a reload the composition page cannot find a pending_diff instance (lane-web-composition-report.md BOUNDARY).
- **Options considered**: (A) new protected GET /api/v1/cms/entries/{entryId}/compositions authorized like CMS-03C-02 returning the current draft revision current-head instances in render order; (B) add a compositions array to CMS-03B-11 EntryDraftDetailResource (evolves a locked BE03b contract); (C) keep the session-only list.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. Root spec detail: items are the existing CompositionInstanceResource (states draft, active, pending_diff; current head per path) in render-plan order (region, slot ordinal, position, path bytewise, id), cursor pages of at most 100 with an opaque nextCursor (PatternSelectorPage convention); 404 hidden/absent entry, 403 visible without edit.
- **Downstream**: BE03c epic index, interaction map, route registry, validation, schema, error kinds, error matrix, authority, changelog; FE03 composition page/list rows; contracts; SQL read + platform_api wrapper; Worker route; Web composition page loader (lift the session-only boundary).
- **Reversibility**: High (additive read).

title: DEC-207: Capability-grant revocation does not enqueue the governed recheck job (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c Invalidation paragraph and P2-S12-AC-202 listed the capability-grant revocation transaction among the enqueuers of cms.governed_review.recheck, but the job selects by dependency (kind, ref_id) over block/pattern/content_type/canonical_domain, which cannot name a revoked person; DEC-180 G6 already has the revoking transaction call cms_invalidate_governed_reviews_for_person synchronously, mirroring BE03b (whose Slice 11 recheck is enqueued by event consumers only).
- **Options considered**: (A) drop revocation from the enqueuers, revocation covered by the synchronous AC-204 path; (B) add a new person dependency kind so revocation also enqueues a recheck.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. BE03c Invalidation paragraph, changelog and AC-202 (tracker, phase-2.md, depth-floor ledger, evidence ledger claim and clause; identical bodies) updated.
- **Downstream**: governed-recheck lane implementation (no revocation enqueue) stands; AC-202 provable as written.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: Lane-report claims of shared-file wiring must be checked on disk at integration (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: Multi-lane work where a lane edits a shared runtime file (e.g. apps/worker/src/production-async-entrypoint.ts) and later lanes rewrite the same file from HEAD.
- **Pattern**: The taxonomy-terms lane report said it wired convergeTaxonomyMerge into the production async entrypoint; on 2026-10-22 the file never contained it, so every cms.taxonomy.merge_converge job failed DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE while the lane report and focused tests looked green. At each integration point, re-run the FULL unit suite (not only focused files) and grep shared wiring files for each claimed registration before accepting a lane as done.
- **Source**: full unit baseline 2026-10-22 (production-async-entrypoint-taxonomy-merge.test.ts 4 fails), root cause found by claude_s12_integ_web_worker.

title: DEC-208: Database-side locale observability via a periodic service-role aggregate read (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c Observability names cms_locale_fanout_total, cms_locale_stale_total and the alert stale locale legal-field count > 0, all arising inside PostgreSQL transactions with no specified path to Worker metrics; the cms.localization.changed.v1 payload {entryId, locale, revisionId} cannot distinguish fan-out from author writes; BE03c labels cms_locale_stale_total{locale} while forbidding locale text in labels.
- **Options considered**: (A) one service-role aggregate RPC read by a scheduled Worker tick returning counts appended since a cursor (fan-out rows, newly stale fields) and the current stale no_fallback field count, Worker emits counter deltas and an alert gauge; (B) extend the event payload with cause and staleFieldCount plus a gauge read; (C) drop the counters and alert from Phase 2.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. The locale label is dropped from cms_locale_stale_total (labels never carry locale text). Legal fields are the no_fallback fields (BE03c 1617/1658).
- **Downstream**: BE03c Observability rows; SQL aggregate RPC + platform_api wrapper (service_role only, no ids or locale text returned beyond counts); Worker scheduled tick + counters + gauge + alert input; AC-052/263/264 evidence.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: DEC-209: Conflict resolution carries composition from the current draft, not the conflict base (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: Review R1-002: dec193 WIP 20261016042200 anchors cms_resolve_conflict carry-over on the conflict BASE revision (BE03c receiving obligation 4 / DEC-198 literal), but CMS-03C-02/15 write composition only to the current draft (theirs), so every resolved conflict silently dropped placements, accepts and detaches made since the base; no UI resolves composition.
- **Options considered**: (A) carry from the current draft theirs; (B) keep base and document the loss in BE03c and FE copy; (C) refuse resolution when composition diverged.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. Amends DEC-198 for cms_resolve_conflict only; cms_create_revision still carries from its base revision. BE03c obligation 4, changelog and AC-245 (tracker, phase-2.md, evidence ledger claim and clause; depth-floor row is historical derivation, unchanged) updated.
- **Downstream**: dec193 042200 resolve anchor theirs_row.id; dec193_carry CC-RES oracles; review before promotion.
- **Reversibility**: Medium (before promotion: high).

title: DEC-210: Enforce block allowedChildren and slotRules everywhere a composition tree is written or published (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: Review R1-001: only the unpromoted CMS-03C-15 writer (dec193 041600) checked registry allowedChildren/slotRules, so a pattern could be saved and placed and later refused at accept/detach; no spec row or RED test existed.
- **Options considered**: (A) enforce everywhere: CMS-03C-12 save, CMS-03C-02 placement, CMS-03C-15 accept/detach, cms.pattern.active_digest provider; (B) declarative only, remove writer checks; (C) enforce at definition and publication only.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. Root wrote the BE03c paragraph Block composition rules (DEC-210): per expanded block node, children keys in allowedChildren, subtree nodes/levels within slotRules; 422 COMPOSITION_VALIDATION_FAILED reasonCode block_rules_violated with operation pointers; provider reason pattern_block_rules_violated. Block versions are immutable, so rules of a pinned version never change; the provider catches patterns saved before the rule.
- **Downstream**: SQL (fix-forward patches of CMS-03C-12 save, CMS-03C-02 placement, provider; writer pointers/reason), contracts (reason code + provider closed reason set), Worker/Web error copy, RED pgTAP per refusal and boundary.
- **Reversibility**: Medium.

title: DEC-211: Dependency-failure retry schedule is split by caller (browser vs server/queue/job) (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c error-matrix retry cells told every caller to retry 502/503/504 at 15s/60s/300s with jitter (BE00:550 queue-consumer schedule copied into HTTP rows) while FE03:1216 has the browser retry at most twice after 250/750 ms; P2-S12-AC-169 asserted 15/60/300 s for an interactive read, unprovable against the real client.
- **Options considered**: (A) split by caller; (B) browser uses 15/60/300 s; (C) drop retry clauses from criteria.
- **Decision**: Owner chose A on 2026-10-22. All ten BE03c retry cells and AC-169 (tracker, phase-2.md, evidence ledger, depth-floor row) now say: browser callers at most two retries after 250 ms and 750 ms for safe operations (FE03 Degradation); server, queue and job callers at most three at 15s/60s/300s with jitter, circuit open 60s. AC-145 (job schedule) unchanged.
- **Downstream**: AC-169 clause citable against web retry tests; no code change.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: DEC-212: Rename the DEC-194 recovery table out of the cms_ namespace and ratify its mutex (implementation decision, owner may override) (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: Review R2-01/R2-02: dec194 WIP creates platform_private.cms_taxonomy_merge_recoveries, which breaks four canonical S09 cms_ aggregate pins (AC-015 envelope, AC-181 policy form, AC-215 guard triggers, sec2 forced set), and BE03c/runbook text said the sweep writes nothing else, 03c has exactly fifteen tables and the merge lock order lacked the per-party mutex.
- **Options considered**: (A) rename to platform_private.taxonomy_merge_recoveries (non-aggregate support table, precedent projection_consumer_state), update sec2 and r8 inventories only; (B) keep the name and add carve-outs to three structural pins.
- **Decision**: Root chose A (implementation tier; owner may override): job-recovery identity is not a CMS aggregate, so the generic invariants stay carve-out free. BE03c Merge convergence recovery, Database Schema and Slice 12 lock order rows plus the runbook updated; AC-261 inventory refresh deferred to the final function-set cascade.
- **Downstream**: lane F3 renames table/policies/tests before promotion and re-earns dec194 evidence.
- **Reversibility**: High before promotion.

title: DEC-213: DEC-208 mechanism — per-minute window read cms_locale_observability_read (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: DEC-208 chose a periodic service-role aggregate read but left the cursor, window, return shape, indexes and gauge unspecified; the Worker is stateless between cron firings.
- **Options considered**: (A) pure read over a closed-open one-minute window derived from the cron scheduledTime, lagged two minutes; (B) a database watermark row advanced by the read (exact under repeated firings, but the read writes); (C) Worker-side cursor in KV or a Durable Object (new infrastructure).
- **Decision**: Root (implementation tier) chose A: platform_api.cms_locale_observability_read(p_window_start, p_window_end), window [T-3m, T-2m), service_role only, no lock, no write, statement_timeout 5 s, answers {fanoutRows, staleFieldsAppended, staleLegalFields}; stale rows are fan-out rows (only the fan-out writes state stale); staleLegalFields counts no_fallback stale fields over each entry current locale variant; new gauge cms_locale_stale_legal_fields feeds the alert; two indexes on cms_locale_variants. A missed or repeated firing under- or over-counts one minute of the counters only; the alert reads the gauge. Owner may override.
- **Downstream**: BE03c Observability paragraph Database-side locale observability (DEC-208) and changelog; DEC-208 implementation lane (WIP migration + Worker tick + gauge + alert input); AC-261 RPC inventory cascade.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: PAT-030: A handed-off root session can still host live lanes (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: Resuming orchestration in a new chat while the previous root session process is still alive.
- **Pattern**: Background subagents run inside their parent session process; a handoff note does not stop it. Check list_sessions/ListAgents and the predecessor transcript, message it to stand down (no releases, edits, gates or TaskStop; relay lane Status lines), never stop it while lanes run, and track lanes by report mtime and a Status-line monitor. Relaunching would put two agents on one claim; stopping would kill lanes mid-run.
- **Source**: 2026-10-22 resume: STATE.md said the previous root ended, yet its four fix lanes were minutes old and held the ALT lock.

title: DEC-214: Render plan lists each row root plus its effective-tree descendants; pointer grammar /composition/{rowId}/nodes/{i} (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: R1-008 / lane F1 BOUNDARY: BE03c said the render plan reads each row as one block at its own path, while the DEC-193 code emits one plan and checker entry per node of the effective tree for linked rows too, with ordinal pointers no spec named.
- **Options considered**: (A) ratify the implementation: root plus descendants for every row, pointer /composition/{rowId} and /composition/{rowId}/nodes/{i} in canonical preorder; (B) descendants only for detached trees (linked roots would render without their pinned children, and the checker would not see blocks readers get).
- **Decision**: Root chose A as a spec clarification, not a product change: the existing detached-tree rule (descendants from the tree, never from pin or overrides) already implies other rows render from pin plus overrides, and the checker must see what readers get. Pointer is an identity, not a client address. Owner may override.
- **Downstream**: BE03c Pattern versions paragraph + changelog; P2-S12-AC-247 text (phase-2, tracker, ledger).
- **Reversibility**: Medium.

title: DEC-215: Squash superseded dec193/pattern-updates migration bodies before promotion (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Problem**: R1-004: pairs 040700/041800, 040800/041600, 041100/041500, 041900/042900, 044500/044710, 044600/044720 and pattern-updates 140200..140600 would freeze known-defective intermediate bodies into immutable history; 044710/044720/044800 pin earlier bodies by md5/sha256.
- **Options considered**: (A) squash each pair into its first file, delete the superseding file and the digest pins, rerun the affected suites; (B) promote as is and treat the files as untouchable.
- **Decision**: Root chose A (implementation tier): no shared database has applied any file from 20261013300000 on, so history can still be clean; a reader of the migrations should not meet defective bodies fixed later in the same promotion. Runs after F2 (which owns dec193/20261016041600) and before joint promotion, as its own lane with a full Slice 12 + Slice 10/11 rerun.
- **Downstream**: dec193 and pattern-updates WIP files, digest pins, promotion manifest.
- **Reversibility**: High until promotion.
